name: Launch of a New Business
summary: I helped pitch and start OpenHomes inside a local incubator, then owned an iOS prototype, a home-search site, and a lower-commission agency. I also designed a simpler door-hardware version, which stalled for lack of resources.

matchingMetadata.title: Launch of a New Business

role_links.note: Scott placed this under OpenHomes. One catch-all for the launch. Do not split the pitch, prototype, website, agency setup, or hardware exploration unless he asks.

employer_links.note: OpenHomes is the company he helped start. The incubator is gener8tor on the employer record; he called it Generator. It is not a customer or client.

matchingMetadata.year_note: The account does not date the work. 2013 is the gener8tor summer cohort year already on C007, inside the R010 tenure (June 2013–August 2014).

evidence.statement: Took part in the incubator pitch and figured out how OpenHomes could operate as a regulated real estate agency, including how listing information got into the product.

sources.locator: Account summary — starting the company and the idea
sources.supports: He was in the pitch, and he says he figured out the regulated agency path and how to get listing information in. They were a functioning agency the whole time.

limitations: He does not want other people on the company recorded, so sole-founder ownership is not claimed.
3% versus 6% is his account, not a measured commission result.
Funding amount is not in this account. A separate employer citation of $180,000 is not this claim.

evidence.statement: Designed and built a live home-search application, including an iOS feel-prototype and a working site with weighted search and location search.

sources.supports: iOS prototype, live search website, weighted search, location search, and his statement that everything was live and working. Design responsibility was fully his.

limitations: “Live video” remains his unclear wording and is not a separate product claim.
Weighted and location search have no approved concept. This is not semantic search.
Artifacts exist and were deferred to presentation. They were not inspected.

evidence.statement: Designed a simpler version of door-opening hardware. That work stalled because the resources to build the hardware never arrived.

sources.supports: He tried to design a simpler version. It did not ship.

limitations: The simpler version is not described as built or shipped.
